releaseNotes: Large 1920-1999 historical gap sweep: 40 class eras, 46 tracks and 118 representative competition models.
Adds AAA/USAC/CART/IRL, NASCAR, WRC, Can-Am/F5000, missing Formula 1 eras, Super Touring, JGTC, late Group C/IMSA WSC and GT1 context.
Research-index entries are classification/context-only and do not promote unsourced tire physics or fitment.
Track entries are historical context and are never automatic grip multipliers.
Adds 13 curated pre-war Mercedes-Benz and Bugatti racing/record profiles spanning 1908-1939, including exact source-backed axle fitments.
Adds 23 evidence-gated fitment overrides for period tire-size notation and the documented Mercedes-Benz W 154 fitment change above 270 km/h.
Extends FAM001/CLS001 to 1908-1939 while retaining the existing numerical grip, rate, pressure, thermal and wear priors unchanged.
Adds guardrails that vehicle record speeds are context rather than tire ratings, and wheel-change counts are not direct tire-life measurements.
Resolves source/profile ID collisions by reserving SRC047-SRC060 for pre-war evidence and remapping the Ligier/1976 records to SRC061-SRC065 and CAR021.

scalingRules.name: Historical geometry notation
scalingRules.evidence: Period tire-size designations must be preserved exactly and interpreted by the notation standard of that era.
scalingRules.implementation: Use exact front/rear source notation as a geometry override. Do not convert 815 x 105, 710 x 90, 27 x 4.40 or inch-rim formats without a period-specific conversion source.
scalingRules.notes: Direct manufacturer/marque archive fitments; rule prevents false modern normalization.

scalingRules.name: High-speed fitment selection
scalingRules.evidence: Pre-war high-speed cars could use explicitly different tire diameters/sizes for load and speed; the W 154 archive specifies a fitment change above 270 km/h.
scalingRules.implementation: When historical_mode is true, select the exact car/event axle fitment and apply documented speed thresholds. Never extrapolate the W 154 threshold into a universal tire speed law or rating.
scalingRules.notes: Direct manufacturer archive evidence with corroboration; generalization beyond exact fitments is prohibited.

scalingRules.name: Race-service evidence
scalingRules.evidence: Wheel or rim change counts are operational evidence, not direct tire-wear or tire-life measurements.
scalingRules.implementation: Store service counts and duration as context. Do not change wear/life coefficients unless laps, distance, cause and tire identity are independently attributable.
scalingRules.notes: The 1908 account records 11 wheel changes in 6 h 46 min but does not isolate tread life.

guardrails: Classification and historical context only: entries do not directly modify tire grip, load sensitivity, wear, pressure or thermal parameters.
No tire size, supplier or construction fact is promoted to runtime fitment without car/event-specific evidence.
Rally and mixed-surface entries require surface-specific evidence before any tire behavior is inferred.
Track entries describe historical context and must not be used as automatic grip multipliers.
